title: AI Chess LIVE 24/7: GPT-6.1 vs Sonnet 5.5 vs DeepSeek vs Stockfish 19 | AIs That Learn
description_lines: Five AI models play a non-stop chess tournament, live, around the clock: against each other and against Stockfish 19.
- Every AI keeps its own memory. It writes notes while it plays and reads them before its next game, so it can learn from its mistakes.
- Stockfish 19 starts at depth 4. Every time an AI beats it, Stockfish gets 1 level deeper.
- Spoken commentary follows the games as they happen.
Live boards, standings and what every model is thinking: https://marvijo.com/ai-chess
The memory and notes of every AI: https://github.com/marvijo-code/ai-chess-agent-memory
